title: Day 1 Forecast Discussion
discussion:
Moderate thunderstorms are expected today

---Discussion---

Another Cold front will come through Central Europe.

Morning thunderstorms will begin (are already present) in Germany, going to Czechia at around 7:00 - 8:00 CEST.

Theses storms will be in an organized MCS, with potentially stronger winds.

The system will then move into Poland where it will become less organized and more isolated cells into early evening.

Austrian situation looks a bit more concerning, with supercells possible in the entire S Austria.

These may be present for a few hours over the locations, but will eventually move into Hungary where they will still be strong but gradually will dissipate.

NW Germany will experience more of a rainshowers/thunderstorms situation, with few brief thunderstorms.
